# Check catalogue
Our reading as students, not legal advice. Decision support only; a human decides. All data is fictitious.

Ruleset version: `rs-02de835ec068` | Checks registered: 55 | Planned in the plan but not registered: 0

## How to read this

- Default severity is a starting guess; it is recalibrated from the eval (docs/validation-report.md).
- Coverage is the number of checks that ran divided by the number that applied to the case; a check that could not run is listed as skipped, never as passed.
- "Tamper caught" is the edit the check is meant to catch.
- This file shows the code defaults only. Officers can switch a check off, change its severity or edit its name, description and note in the check catalogue (`GET /rules` shows the effective settings, `GET /rules/changes` the change log); those overrides are never written to this file.
